leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useEffect hook to manage side effects in functional components.
Implement dependency arrays to control when side effects execute.
Use TypeScript generics to type the useEffect hook's callback function.
Construct cleanup functions to prevent memory leaks from side effects.
Execute conditional logic within useEffect to skip unnecessary effect runs.
Define state variables with useState that trigger side effects when updated.
Invoke useEffect with an empty dependency array to run side effects only on mount.
Utilize the useEffect hook to synchronize component state with external data sources.
Handle asynchronous operations within useEffect using async/await patterns.
Return cleanup functions from useEffect to unsubscribe from event listeners or timers.
Access previous state or props values within useEffect using refs or dependency arrays.
Modify DOM elements directly within useEffect while maintaining React's declarative model.
